sample_observation: Main thread waited in autograd backward. Metal GPU stream sampled linear backward (57/83) and softmax backward (19/83), including command-buffer semaphore waits. This was not validation or checkpoint saving during the sampled second.
timing_scope: Cumulative wall time includes initial validation and step-100 validation. Not a pure training-update throughput measurement; prior system sleep is not excluded.
inference: Memory pressure is a strong contributor to the slowdown, not proven to explain every second of the historical interval.
preservation: Running SFT and collectors were not stopped or patched. SFT checkpoints contain weights, not optimizer/RNG state; an exact lossless restart is unavailable.
next_process_optimization: Microbatch four examples within each unchanged effective batch; preserve example/token/auxiliary-intent denominators for SFT and separate all-row/present-row denominators for the reader. Project vocabulary logits only at supervised positions for SFT.
